docs.title: configure_logging()
docs.text:
Configure loguru for console and file logging.

Removes the default handler and sets up: - stderr handler at LOG_LEVEL (default: INFO, configurable via env var) - File handler at DEBUG level writing to LOG_FILE (default: app.log)

Source code in src/myapp/app.py 
def configure_logging():
    """Configure loguru for console and file logging.

    Removes the default handler and sets up:
    - stderr handler at LOG_LEVEL (default: INFO, configurable via env var)
    - File handler at DEBUG level writing to LOG_FILE (default: app.log)
    """
    import os

    log_level = os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO")
    log_file = os.environ.get("LOG_FILE", "app.log")
    logger.remove()
    logger.add(sys.stderr, level=log_level)
    logger.add(log_file, level="DEBUG", rotation="50 KB", retention=1)

docs.title: main()
docs.text:
Run the application.

Configures logging and prints a greeting to verify the setup works.

Source code in src/myapp/app.py 
@logger.catch
def main():
    """Run the application.

    Configures logging and prints a greeting to verify the setup works.
    """
    configure_logging()
    logger.info("Hello from myapp!")

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Clone the repository and install dependencies:

uv sync

docs.title: Running
docs.text:
Via the CLI entrypoint:

uv run myapp                          # production defaults
uv run --env-file .env myapp          # dev settings

Or as a Python module:

uv run python -m myapp
